open_constraints.title: External relationship-building is human-only
open_constraints.summary: The system cannot build trust relationships with external stakeholders, product managers, or cross-functional teams. This is a permanent constraint — not closable by the system.
open_constraints.relevance: Affects all outputs intended for external stakeholders — dual-layer output standard partially addresses this

open_constraints.title: The dataset generator has no live query API
open_constraints.summary: Diagnostic Agent monitors generated file outputs, not live results. DuckDB mitigates by reading Parquet exports.
open_constraints.relevance: Data ingestion layer only — does not affect Phase 1+ operations after dataset is loaded into DuckDB

open_constraints.title: Claude Code sequential execution limits Phase 4+ concurrency
open_constraints.summary: Architecture abstractions allow Claude Agent SDK swap when needed. Not blocking for Phases 0-3.
open_constraints.relevance: Phase 4+ only — not a current blocker
